coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web discovery: 21 actual captured searches in English, Arabic and Sorani yielded 487 exact ordered result headers and 31 recorded source cards. Only the Shafaq Dukan Dam story (S002) has a full exposed article-body read; 30 cards remain search_only. Four provisional event records remain pending review, alongside 15 evidence gaps. Search results and this limited source set are not an exhaustive country-month census or proof of absence. LexisNexis and the official baseline were not available to this worker. Event onsets, thresholds, unit boundaries, end dates, origins and state responses remain incomplete; no candidate is officially approved.
